character.description: The same young adult female anime protagonist: platinum-blonde hair in a neat long braid, silver-grey eyes, a composed expression and strong brows; a thoughtful everyday traveler with a keen eye for small moments, wearing a recognizable contemporary outfit with a signature jacket, simple accessories, and comfortable shoes with concrete gray accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in quiet crosswalk, late-night convenience store, overpass walkway; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with midnight blue, amber, concrete gray, neon cyan; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by street-level tracking shot, wide city establishing shot, window reflection close-up; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
